title: VHH Purification Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your custom labware files (with .json extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload your protocol script (.py file) to the OT App on the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to start the protocol.
